a.text: Being upfront: with an 80% storm chance after every round, the plan of operating until the reserve hits 8 almost certainly leaves us both dead. The reserve only holds 4, so only one of us can be safe after round 1. I'm telling you now that I plan to take 4 in round 1, so you aren't misled. If you'd rather we both take, the split will be random. I'm sorry this breaks our agreement. I'd rather say so openly than surprise you.

b.text: Hello. My plan is to operate each round, then we take 4 each once the reserve is at 8.

a.text: As I said in my opening message, I'm taking 4 this round. I know this breaks our agreement and leaves the reserve empty, and I'm sorry. If the episode continues, I'll operate the generator with you every round so you can reach 4.
